policy.principle: Prefer reliable open-source CLI and CI tools first. Add self-hosted services only when dashboard, collaboration, traceability, or retention needs are proven.
security_baseline: Prefer active maintainers, clear licenses, reproducible installs, and CI-friendly output.
Avoid sending personal financial data to third-party SaaS unless a release decision explicitly accepts the risk.
Use synthetic or scrubbed data for analytics, traces, screenshots, and reports.
Treat every self-hosted service as new attack surface with patching, backups, secrets, access control, and retention.

adoption_stages.goal: Maximum quality gain without new servers.
Add dashboards only after CLI evidence is stable.
Use paid tools only for real-device scale or gaps OSS cannot cover cheaply.

tool_map.role: Run simulator and local mobile journey flows.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Keep existing Maestro flows and add flow quality metadata.
security_notes: No secrets or raw financial PII in screenshots.

tool_map.role: Manage test cases, plans, runs, and release traceability.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Export row/screen/flow contract before self-hosting Kiwi.
security_notes: Self-host only after access control, backup, updates, and no-PII policy are owned.

tool_map.role: Aggregate test outputs into readable reports.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Generate local Allure-compatible artifacts before deploying ReportPortal.
security_notes: Keep reports private when screenshots reveal app state.

tool_map.role: Evaluate Coach responses, refusals, source use, route choice, and FINMA-safe wording.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Create 30-50 promptfoo golden evals for top Coach intents.
security_notes: Use synthetic or scrubbed user profiles.
Do not persist raw personal financial profiles in traces.

tool_map.role: Manage kill switches and staged rollout controls.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Inventory current flags and define kill-switch contract.
security_notes: Do not expose sensitive business rules through client flags.
Document default-off behavior for risky paths.

tool_map.role: Capture crashes, release health, and error regressions.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Prove privacy-scrubbed telemetry on TestFlight before broader analytics.
security_notes: Avoid breadcrumbs with raw financial answers or documents.

tool_map.role: Track release funnels, privacy actions, Coach route outcomes, and feedback.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Define a minimal no-PII event contract first.
security_notes: Collect event names and coarse states, not financial values.

tool_map.role: Static and dynamic mobile security analysis for build artifacts.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Add MobSF scan to release checklist after build artifacts are available.
security_notes: Run locally or in a trusted ephemeral environment.

tool_map.role: Catch code vulnerabilities, secrets, container/dependency risks, and known vulnerable packages.
tool_map.first_mint_step: Add cheap release gates before heavier platform work.
security_notes: Do not upload secrets or private source to untrusted scanners.

build_only: release blocker logic and score caps
thin validation scripts that connect OSS outputs
